# ESM2 head results

*Auto-generated by `ml/scripts/eval_esm_head.py`. Bootstrap n=1000, seed=42.*

Backbone (frozen): `facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D` (1280-dim mean-pooled embedding).
